excerpt: OpenAI's September 8 announcement says ChatGPT Images 2.5 adds Sketch, templates, comments placed directly on images, prompt sharing, more precise editing and more consistent multi-turn edits. It says the product is rolling out across all ChatGPT tiers on desktop, mobile and web, plus ChatGPT Work and Codex. The speed, fidelity and quality comparisons are OpenAI claims.
limitations: Primary vendor evidence for the release, interface and stated availability. It does not independently establish performance across accounts, devices or tasks.
